about.size: Large billfish; anglers target numbers on light tackle rather than size
about.swimming_depth: Mostly the upper 20 m, with repeated short dives to 50-150 m below the thermocline (Gulf of Mexico and Florida Straits tagging)
about.behavior: Stays above the thermocline in about 21-28 C water. In winter along the Florida coast the fish travel just outside the outer reef line, often along the green-to-blue water edge; cold fronts concentrate them.
about.regulations_note: Atlantic billfish need a NOAA Fisheries permit for fishing in federal waters, and state rules may also apply. Check before you fish.
about.timing_note: Angler lore: patterns reported by local captains and fishing writers, not tested by studies. Numbers are judgment calls to be calibrated against trip logs.
